value.name: withholds response in silence
value.description: She stays quiet and lets the silence stretch, forcing him to be the first to move.
evidence: She waited inside the quiet and let him be the one who had to move first.

value.name: holds eye contact without moving
value.description: Asha keeps her eyes on Devin and remains physically still, signaling deliberate restraint.
evidence: Asha kept her eyes on Devin and did not move.

value.name: extends silence beyond kindness
value.description: Asha deliberately lets the silence continue past the point where she would normally soften it, revealing a harder edge than usual.
evidence: She let the silence go on past the point where she would normally have softened it, past the point where the kindness she had spent two years building with him would have asked her to speak.

value.name: leaves corrected page unadjusted
value.description: The corrected page remains between them, and Asha refuses to alter the language or fill in the blank line.
evidence: The page lay between them in the lamp's circle, the corrected language stark above the blank line, and she did not adjust it.

value.name: hears movement overhead
value.description: A footstep passes above the ceiling and disappears, adding a brief external interruption to the tense standoff.
evidence: Somewhere above the ceiling a footstep crossed and was gone

value.name: Devin shifts hand slightly
value.description: Devin's hand lifts a fraction from the table edge and settles again, showing restrained hesitation.
evidence: Devin's hand, which had been flat against the table edge, lifted half an inch and settled again.
